question: how to transfer a business email away from Wix
candidate_answer:

This process will disconnect the Workspace business email from your Wix account and is irreversible. After the transfer, you will no longer be able to repurchase the business email through Wix.

- Contact Wix Customer Care to initiate the transfer.
- The transfer disconnects the email from Wix.
- This action cannot be undone.
- Post-transfer, repurchasing the email via Wix is not possible [S1].

question: can I buy a premium plan but build my website on other platforms
candidate_answer:
- Yes, you can purchase a Wix Premium plan but build your website on other platforms; however, Wix Premium plans and their features are specifically designed to work with Wix websites.
- Wix Analytics and other Premium features are integrated within the Wix platform, so benefits like sales reports and custom reports apply only to Wix-hosted sites [S1].
- If your website is hosted elsewhere, you will not be able to use Wix Premium features directly on that site.

In summary, while you can buy a Wix Premium plan, its full functionality is tied to Wix websites and may not be applicable if your site is built on other platforms [S1].
